})

import pandas as pd

# Read source table with index_col=0 as per hint 21
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_13/training_0.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(source_path, index_col=0)

# Strip whitespace from SN column
df['SN'] = df['SN'].str.strip()

# Group by SN and aggregate sum of Price and count of Purchase ID
result = df.groupby('SN', as_index=False).agg({
    'Price': 'sum',
    'Purchase ID': 'count'
})

# Rename columns to match target schema
result.columns = ['SN', 'Total Purchase Value', 'Purchase Count']

# Write output to target file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_13/target_multisource_critique_history.csv"
